---
title: Create Vendor
description: Create a vendor metadata entry referenced by models.
api: "POST /api/vendors/"
---

Creates a vendor metadata entry. Model entries reference a vendor through `vendor_id`, and vendor fields such as the icon, data-retention window, and training opt-out flag are shown to end users on the pricing page.

The vendor name must be non-empty and unique among non-deleted vendors. `id`, `created_time`, and `updated_time` are assigned by the server; the created record is returned in `data`.

Requires **Admin** permissions. See [Authentication](/nookmux/api/management/auth) for how to authenticate management API requests.

## Request

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://your-nookmux-domain/api/vendors/' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'New-Api-User: 1' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "name": "OpenAI",
  "description": "OpenAI models",
  "icon": "openai",
  "data_retention_days": 30,
  "training_opt_out": true,
  "status": 1
}'
```

</RequestExample>

### Body

<ParamField path="body.name" type="string" required>
  Vendor name, unique among non-deleted vendors; limited to 128 characters. Must not be empty.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.description" type="string">
  Free-form description.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.icon" type="string">
  Icon name from `@lobehub/icons`, rendered by the frontend; limited to 128 characters.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.data_retention_days" type="integer">
  Data-retention window in days shown on the pricing page (`0` means no retention). Omit to leave unset.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.training_opt_out" type="boolean">
  Whether requests to this vendor are excluded from upstream model training by default (shown on the pricing page). Omit to leave unset.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.status" type="integer" default="1">
  Reserved status field; `1` means enabled.
</ParamField>

## Response

<ResponseExample>

```json 200
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "id": 3,
    "name": "OpenAI",
    "description": "OpenAI models",
    "icon": "openai",
    "data_retention_days": 30,
    "training_opt_out": true,
    "status": 1,
    "created_time": 1735689600,
    "updated_time": 1735689600
  }
}
```

</ResponseExample>

### Response fields

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean" required>
  Whether the vendor was created.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string" required>
  Error description when `success` is `false`; empty otherwise.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="object" required>
  The created vendor record.

  <Expandable title="vendor structure">
    <ResponseField name="id" type="integer" required>
      Vendor ID assigned by the server.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="name" type="string" required>
      Vendor name.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="description" type="string">
      Free-form description; omitted when empty.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="icon" type="string">
      Icon name from `@lobehub/icons`, rendered by the frontend; omitted when empty.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="data_retention_days" type="integer">
      Data-retention window in days; omitted when unset.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="training_opt_out" type="boolean">
      Whether requests to this vendor are excluded from upstream model training by default; omitted when unset.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="status" type="integer" required>
      Reserved status field; `1` means enabled.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="created_time" type="integer" required>
      Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, set by the server.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="updated_time" type="integer" required>
      Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, set by the server.
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<Note>
Management endpoints return HTTP `200` even on business failures; always check the `success` field. Successful creation is recorded in the admin audit log (vendor module).
</Note>

## Error messages

| Condition | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Invalid request body | The JSON body is missing or malformed |
| Vendor name cannot be empty | `name` is an empty string |
| Vendor name already exists | A non-deleted vendor with the same name already exists |
| Database error, please try again later | The duplicate-name check or the insert failed; see server logs |
